info.title: Brightspace
info.description: Dual-purpose connector for the D2L Brightspace (Valence) Developer Platform API. Exposes typed REST actions for Power Automate and Power Apps alongside an MCP endpoint that gives Copilot Studio agents progressive discovery over the whole Brightspace API through scan, launch, and sequence tools.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio. Exposes the Brightspace API over JSON-RPC 2.0 with progressive discovery through the scan, launch, and sequence tools, plus a version negotiation tool.

get.description: Retrieve the latest supported API contract version for every product component in this Brightspace deployment. Call this first to confirm the version values used by the other actions are supported by your tenant.
Retrieve the user information for the current user context (the Brightspace user the connection is authenticated as).

403.description: No permission to see whoami information for the current user context

404.description: Could not map the current user context to a known user ID

get.description: Retrieve the data for a single user by their Brightspace user ID.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Brightspace user ID (a positive 64-bit integer).

get.description: Retrieve a paged list of all users visible to the current user context. Pass the Bookmark returned in PagingInfo to fetch the next page. To look up a specific user instead, use Find User By Username or Find Users By Org Defined ID.

parameters.name: bookmark
parameters.description: Bookmark from the previous page's PagingInfo. Leave empty for the first page.

403.description: Not authorized to list users

get.description: Find a single user by their Brightspace username. Returns one user record, or 404 when no user matches. The connector script rewrites this to GET /d2l/api/lp/{version}/users/?userName={userName}, which returns a single object rather than a list.

parameters.name: userName
parameters.description: Exact Brightspace username to look up.

403.description: Not authorized to search on username

404.description: No user matches the provided username

get.summary: Find Users By Org Defined ID
get.description: Find users by the organization-defined identifier, such as a student number. Returns an array because the identifier is not guaranteed to be unique. The connector script rewrites this to GET /d2l/api/lp/{version}/users/?orgDefinedId={orgDefinedId}.

parameters.name: orgDefinedId
parameters.description: Organization-defined identifier, for example a student or staff number.

403.description: Not authorized to search on org defined ID

404.description: No user matches the provided org defined ID

get.description: Retrieve a paged list of the org units the current user context is enrolled in, such as the courses a student or instructor is taking or teaching.

parameters.name: orgUnitTypeId
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of org unit type IDs to filter by, for example the course offering type.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Filter to only active or only inactive enrollments.

parameters.name: canAccess
parameters.description: Filter to only enrollments the user can currently access.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort key for the returned list.

parameters.name: startDateTime
parameters.description: Only include enrollments active on or after this UTC date-time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ).

parameters.name: endDateTime
parameters.description: Only include enrollments active on or before this UTC date-time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ).

parameters.name: bookmark
parameters.description: Bookmark from the previous page's PagingInfo. Leave empty for the first page.

200.description: Paged list of the current user's enrollments

400.description: End date-time is earlier than start date-time

LpVersion.name: version
LpVersion.description: Learning Platform (lp) API contract version. 1.49 is the oldest non-deprecated version; raise it only if you need a route added in a later contract. Use Get API Versions to see what this tenant supports.

LeVersion.name: version
LeVersion.description: Learning Environment (le) API contract version. 1.82 is the oldest non-deprecated version; raise it only if you need a route added in a later contract. Use Get API Versions to see what this tenant supports.
